claims.statement: For a two-state reversible folding model I <-> N started in I, p_N(t)=pi_N(1-exp(-(k_f+k_u)t)). Multiplying k_f and k_u by the same positive factor preserves the Boltzmann equilibrium occupancy pi_N but can make p_N(t) arbitrarily close to zero at any fixed finite t. Hence equilibrium occupancy alone supplies no positive finite-time success guarantee above the initial target occupancy.
assumptions: Homogeneous continuous-time Markov dynamics at fixed assay conditions
Detailed balance with the specified equilibrium ensemble
Initial state is the non-target basin I
A finite fixed assay horizon t
claims.novelty_boundary: Standard Markov-chain and transition-state reasoning applied to protein design; no external novelty or priority claim.
claims.costs: The theorem itself requires no data. Applying it requires the initial preparation and a measured or certified kinetic-rate lower bound in addition to equilibrium energies.
claims.falsifier: The mathematical statement is exact under its assumptions. Its model application is rejected if the specified protein is not adequately represented by the two-state reversible process.
claims.next_gate: Measure state-resolved folding and unfolding rates under the intended assay conditions, and verify the single-exponential model with orthogonal probes.

claims.statement: For a finite irreducible reversible chain with stationary law pi, spectral gap gamma, initial law mu and event A, |P_mu(X_t in A)-pi(A)| <= 0.5*sqrt(sum_x mu(x)^2/pi(x)-1)*exp(-gamma*t). Thus pi(A)>=1-delta and gamma*t>=max(0,log(c_mu/(2*(epsilon-delta)))) imply P_mu(X_t in A)>=1-epsilon for epsilon>delta.
assumptions: Reversible generator and spectral gap gamma>0
Known stationary law, initial law and target event
claims.novelty_boundary: Standard L2 spectral-gap contraction; protein-design contribution is the explicit separation of equilibrium inputs from acquired kinetic inputs. No novelty or priority claim.
claims.costs: Applying the bound requires a valid coarse-grained state model, initial distribution, and a certified lower bound on the slowest relaxation rate. A finite set of observed probes does not automatically certify the absence of hidden slower modes.
claims.falsifier: A measured hidden slow mode or failure of the coarse-grained reversible model invalidates its application; without a rate certificate the output remains UNKNOWN.
claims.next_gate: Acquire state-resolved kinetics or directly measure target-basin occupancy at a frozen finite assay time.

claims.statement: Primary studies report that designed Top7 matched its design structure at 1.2 A RMSD but displayed multiphasic folding and a stable nonnative conformation; a later polar-core variant retained multiphasic behavior despite high folding stability, and distinct fluorescence probes exposed different kinetic phases.
assumptions: Claim is restricted to the named Top7 constructs, conditions, and assays
Reported evidence is source-reported primary experimental evidence, not independently replayed data
claims.novelty_boundary: These are established prior experiments. They motivate the kinetic gate and are not presented as a new discovery or as a fitted validation of the two-state theorem.
claims.costs: Literature reconstruction only; no new assays or simulations were performed.
claims.falsifier: A source correction or a demonstrated mismatch between the report's condition/construct statements and the primary papers would require revision.
claims.next_gate: For any prospective design panel, measure equilibrium target fraction and finite-time native-basin occupancy in the same construct and condition.

claims.statement: Top7 pathway/packing optimization for increased folding cooperativity, including mutation-based model designs, was already reported computationally by Yadahalli and Gosavi (2014). A 2022 primary follow-up lists V6I-L29F-I40F-F71V-I79V-F83V as a candidate repacking sequence. No experiment measuring fixed-time native-basin occupancy for this six-substitution sequence was found in the bounded primary-source search.
assumptions: Prior-art finding is scoped to the primary sources retrieved for this audit
The six-substitution sequence is attributed through the 2022 primary follow-up to earlier Top7 packing work
Absence from the retrieved sources is not proof that no later experiment exists
claims.novelty_boundary: The Top7 cooperativity intervention and sequence-level route are preempted. A direct finite-time assay is proposed as validation of prior computational work, not claimed as a new mechanism or result. Novelty of the empirical gap remains unverified.
claims.costs: No sequence was synthesized or assayed here. Prospective comparison: WT, N-terminal triple, C-terminal triple, six-mutant combination; equilibrium stability, orthogonal state-specific structure measurements, time-resolved kinetics and finite-time occupancy.
claims.falsifier: A later primary experimental report measuring fixed-time native-basin occupancy for the named six-mutant would close the identified evidence gap; measured lack of an occupancy gain would refute the proposed practical prediction.
claims.next_gate: Before claiming new work, check for any post-2022 primary experimental validation of the exact combination; otherwise run the four-genotype, frozen-time assay described in the report.

claims.statement: If n independent direct refolding trials all occupy a calibrated target basin at the prespecified assay time, the exact one-sided 1-alpha lower confidence bound on success probability is alpha^(1/n). This supports a finite-panel design gate without assuming a kinetic state graph.
assumptions: Independent trials from the declared construct and assay distribution
Target-basin assay has validated specificity and detection properties
Assay time, buffer, temperature, initial preparation and target basin are frozen before evaluation
claims.novelty_boundary: Exact binomial confidence bound is standard. It certifies only the tested construct, conditions, time and assay; no broad generalization is claimed.
claims.costs: For one frozen candidate, 29 all-success independent trials give a 95% lower bound of 90%; 59 give a 95% lower bound of 95%. Simultaneous certification across 12 candidates at 90% with Bonferroni requires 53 trials per candidate.
claims.falsifier: Any observed failure prevents the all-success shortcut; use the general one-sided exact binomial bound. Assay misclassification or dependence voids the stated guarantee.
claims.next_gate: Compare kinetic-aware and equilibrium-only rankings on stability-matched, blinded sequences using direct occupancy at the same frozen assay time.

overall_novelty_status: The Top7 packing/cooperativity design route is preempted by 2014 computational prior art; a primary-source search did not find experimental finite-time validation of the listed six-mutant. Novelty of that empirical gap is UNKNOWN, and no new scientific advance is claimed here.
principal_limitation: The exact finite-time theorem is conditional on a valid reversible kinetic model. Top7 demonstrates that single-exponential coarse-graining and single-probe state assignment can fail.
next_decision: Check for later primary experimental validation of V6I-L29F-I40F-F71V-I79V-F83V; if absent, directly measure finite-time native-basin occupancy with WT and block controls before making any empirical claim.
